text: Just getting here was so satisfying!\nI can’t imagine what seeing the ruins will feel like!
Every time I see the ruins, I’m enamored of them.\nWhy are they so appealing to me, I wonder...

The Gym Stadiums of the Galar region are
built on these Power Spots.
